NOTES: utilz-vc has taken the rule that any commit into Intent's checkout is announced to intent-vc before the commit, even on hv's word; the stamps memory carries the message-only-turn rule (read the clock first or send no stamp). Standing: no push, no release, never --no-confirm, never intent fc; commits by literal path with --only, never a peer's board render; commit messages and long board texts from files; the census call carries only the script, git add and git commit; crossed CHAIN STARTs go cc < dc < vc; a peer's CHAIN START means no commits and no wb writes from vc until its END. UTILZ: hv's 2.14.0 run stopped at step 5 on prez AT21 under shared load (utilz-dc's run alone PASSED, a Chrome flake), hv reran it, and Utilz 2.14.0 is TAGGED at 069e0f3 with hv's terminal at step 11 waiting on CI; utilz-vc's runbook trigger ("Utilz 2.14.0 tagged at 069e0f3, run the kovacs runbook") relayed to kovacs-sysadm at vc's 09:50Z with the condition that step (c)'s prez build waits for R1's END; the Report comes back through vc.
